motions.item_title: Approve the minutes of June 9, 2026, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Free seconded th…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to approve the minutes of June 9, 2026, Planning Commission meeting. Commissioner Free seconded the motion.
motions.headline: June 9 minutes approved
motions.summary: The commission approved the written record of its June 9, 2026 meeting.
motions.impact: Housekeeping for the clerk's file, and nothing more.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Annexation Policy Plan. Commissioner DeCou…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.A., Annexation Policy Plan. Commissioner DeCoursey seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Annexation policy plan
motions.summary: Commissioners took up the city's annexation policy plan, the document that sets which land Eagle Mountain may take in, and sent it toward the council.
motions.impact: The minutes do not record how the vote came out. Annexation shapes the city's future boundaries, so this one is worth watching when the council picks it up.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., Triumph Master Development Agreement 2nd A…
motions.motion: Commissioner Allen moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.B., Triumph Master Development Agreement 2nd Amendment. Commissioner Free seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Triumph development agreement change
motions.summary: The commission recommended a second amendment to the Triumph master development agreement, which sets the terms for that development.
motions.impact: The record does not say what the amendment changes. Neighbors of the Triumph project are the ones with a reason to follow it to the council.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.C., EMMC 17.75.052 – Accessory Recreation Buil…
motions.motion: Commissioner Free moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.C., EMMC 17.75.052 – Accessory Recreation Buildings. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Backyard recreation buildings
motions.summary: Over one commissioner's objection, the commission recommended a new code section on accessory recreation buildings.
motions.impact: This governs what you may build on your own lot alongside your house, such as a detached recreation structure. The council has the final say.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., EMMC 17.10.030, 17.80.120, 17.160 – Season…
motions.motion: Commissioner DeCoursey moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.D., EMMC 17.10.030, 17.80.120, 17.160 – Seasonal Political Signs with the correction of a small clerical error. Commissioner Jensen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Seasonal political sign rules
motions.summary: Commissioners backed changes to the city's rules on seasonal political signs, with one clerical error corrected before it moves to the council.
motions.impact: If the council agrees, the rules for putting campaign signs on your property around an election would change. Nothing is in force yet.

motions.item_title: Recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., EMMC 16.20, 16.25, 17.100 – Cost Estimate.…
motions.motion: Commissioner Free moved to recommend approval to the City Council of Item 7.E., EMMC 16.20, 16.25, 17.100 – Cost Estimate. Commissioner Allen seconded the motion.
motions.headline: Cost estimate rules for subdivision work
motions.summary: The commission asked the council to update the code sections covering cost estimates for subdivision and development work.
motions.impact: The council makes the call at a later meeting. Engineers and developers pricing out required improvements would feel this; a homeowner would not.
